entries.070479f8c7444871: This business develops, manufactures and sells printing-related equipment and provides maintenance services. SCREEN Graphic Solutions Co., Ltd. is in charge of it; domestic sales are handled by SCREEN GP Japan Co., Ltd., maintenance services by SCREEN GP Service East Japan Co., Ltd. and SCREEN GP Service West Japan Co., Ltd., and overseas operations by SCREEN GP Americas, LLC (U.S.), SCREEN GP Europe B.V. (Netherlands), SCREEN GA Shanghai Co., Ltd. (China) and SCREEN GP Australia PTY., Ltd. (Australia). In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥57,347 million and segment profit was ¥3,602 million, making it the second-largest business after SPE. The number of employees is 890. The company explains that revenue increased because of higher sales of equipment and recurring business centered on ink (revenue that recurs after delivery), but profit declined due to higher fixed costs and the impact of U.S. tariffs.
entries.09e3ebe96f224ca1: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥122,522 million, down 9.7% from the previous fiscal year. The company explains that this was due to higher fixed costs, such as R&D expenses and personnel expenses for growth, and lower revenue. Ordinary profit fell 10.1% to ¥124,323 million, and profit attributable to owners of parent fell 7.5% to ¥92,003 million. Segment profit was SPE122,707 million yen, FT8,605 million yen, GA3,602 million yen, PE383 million yen and Other -2,435 million yen. A caution is needed here. The total profit of the 4 reportable segments, ¥135,298 million, does not match consolidated operating profit of ¥122,522 million. The adjustment amount of -¥10,340 million making up the difference is, as Note 2 of the Annual Securities Report states, "profit and loss of the Company not allocated to business segments, etc.", that is, the holding company's own expenses. Segment figures cannot be added up to obtain operating profit.

entries.1afd33ea74fca31d: Because the equipment is delivered as factory facilities, customers are manufacturing companies, not end consumers. The only customer named in the Annual Securities Report is 1 company, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, Ltd., with revenue of ¥88,507 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, or 14.6% of total sales results (previous fiscal year: ¥89,703 million, 14.3%). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 by customer location was China ¥232,534 million (38.4%), Taiwan ¥135,987 million (22.4%), Japan ¥85,639 million (14.1%), the United States ¥49,637 million (8.2%), South Korea ¥39,074 million (6.5%), Other ¥36,819 million (6.1%) and Europe ¥26,055 million (4.3%). The Annual Securities Report states: "Order results are not stated because they fluctuate greatly in the short term and are not appropriate as an indicator of medium- to long-term market trends or the state of the Group's business."

entries.5a660bc9de2e72a1: The company describes its core technologies as 'interface control technology' and 'imaging technology', together with 'systemization technology', which connects these. Interface control technology leads to cleaning equipment that removes fine contamination from the surfaces of semiconductor wafers, and imaging technology leads to printing presses and direct-imaging equipment that draws patterns directly onto substrates. The annual securities report describes 'the cleaning field, in which the group holds a top share', and cleaning is this company's strong field. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, it developed the direct-imaging exposure equipment 'DW-3100', claimed to offer world-class high resolution, for the advanced semiconductor packaging market; in the advanced device field, it concluded an additional agreement with IBM on the development of next-generation cleaning processes; and it also collaborates with overseas research institutions such as imec (Interuniversity Microelectronics Centre).

entries.a47fce0f51fe2483: This business develops, manufactures, and sells equipment for manufacturing semiconductors and provides maintenance services. SCREEN Semiconductor Solutions Co., Ltd. is in charge, supported by SCREEN SPE Tech Co., Ltd. (development and manufacturing), SCREEN SPE Works Co., Ltd. (assembly), SCREEN SPE Quartz Co., Ltd. (manufacture of equipment parts), and SCREEN SPE Service Co., Ltd. (maintenance services), and sales support companies in Taiwan, South Korea, China, Singapore, the United States, and Germany handle overseas operations. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, of consolidated net sales of ¥605,748 million, net sales to external customers of ¥485,344 million were from this business, and segment profit was also ¥122,707 million, making it by far the largest business among the 4 reporting segments. The core company, SCREEN Semiconductor Solutions Co., Ltd., by itself as 1 company had net sales of ¥448,468 million, exceeding 10% of consolidated net sales, so the annual securities report discloses its profit and loss individually (ordinary profit of ¥110,387 million and net profit of ¥81,884 million). The number of employees is 3,932. In the same year, sales decreased and profit decreased because, while post-sales (sales of maintenance, parts, and other products after delivery) and sales of equipment for DRAM increased, sales of equipment for foundries decreased, and by region, sales to Taiwan increased while sales to China and the United States decreased. Its largest customer is Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, Ltd., and net sales to that company were ¥88,507 million.
